inherited_context.scope: The inherited schema context is retained for causal continuity; it is not a declaration that this seven-module delta formalizes every result of the corpus.

focal_genealogical_receipt.1_app_object_domain_sheets_operation: The selected regional incidence imported from the APP-origin chain is retained. This delta begins after that selection and neither changes its sheets nor recomputes its seed census.
focal_genealogical_receipt.2_trit_state_regime_orientation: The same generated ternary regional data determine the inherited marked origin; the field construction varies no upstream ternary datum.
focal_genealogical_receipt.3_tpk_effective_composition: SelectedRegionalIncidence.selectedOrigin -> LatticeCocycle.Lattice selectedOrigin -> LatticeOscillatorFock.LatticeCarrier -> LatticeNormalOrderedField.normalField -> LatticeStateFieldMap.stateField -> SelectedStateField.Y.
focal_genealogical_receipt.4_coefficient_origins: The bilinear form and cocycle come from the existing marked lattice. Divided derivative coefficients are proved from finite falling products/binomial identities. No empirical constant or target character is used to choose coefficients.
focal_genealogical_receipt.5_conserved_information: The same selected origin, lattice charge, oscillator multiplicities, carrier, vacuum and fields are retained. Word multiplicities are exact and arbitrary finite occupations are admitted. The upstream residue/carry/memory data are not reset or reselected by this downstream construction.
focal_genealogical_receipt.6_enriched_state_and_residence: The selected lattice is the already constructed exceptional publication of the shared regional origin. No second lattice is supplied as an independent state. Preservation here means reuse of that exact typed object, not a new theorem that the entire preceding history can be recovered from one field coefficient.
focal_genealogical_receipt.7_produced_output: A linear map from the full existing carrier to Laurent vertex operators; creation, vacuum, injection, pointwise truncation and agreement with the existing charged and divided Heisenberg fields are proved.
focal_genealogical_receipt.8_posterior_recognition_and_falsifier: The LaTeX subsequently applies the classical FLM theorem after its lattice construction. This delta does not insert FLM, Jacobi or the Monster identification as axioms. A changed coefficient, lost creation identity, unbounded lower Laurent support or changed selected carrier would falsify the concrete implementation claims checked here.
